kinora.editor.fly_hint: Hold the right mouse button over the world to fly; press New Shot to start filming from here.

kinora.editor.new_shot.tooltip: Start a 5-second shot at the current replay time (Ctrl+N)
kinora.editor.pick_prompt: Click an entity (or a block for a point) to pick it; any other button cancels
kinora.editor.render.tooltip: Render the shot or the whole sequence to video
kinora.editor.save.tooltip: Save the project (Ctrl+S). Changes are also autosaved every 30 seconds.
kinora.editor.templates.tooltip: Insert a classic camera move aimed at what you are looking at
kinora.editor.view.tooltip: Edit one shot, or play all shots in order with their transitions

kinora.editor.undo.label: Undo
kinora.editor.redo.label: Redo
kinora.editor.play.label: Play
kinora.editor.pause.label: Pause
kinora.render.too_large: This graphics card renders at most %s pixels on a side. Use a smaller size or less supersampling.
kinora.render.no_ffmpeg: Video needs FFmpeg. Put ffmpeg.exe in kinora/tools, set its path in Kinora's settings, or render an image sequence.
kinora.render.stopped_hint: Resume it from the render queue.
kinora.render.progress.title: Rendering %s
kinora.render.progress.stop: Esc stops; the render can be resumed later
kinora.render.preset.tooltip: Ready-made settings. Click for the next one, Shift-click for the previous.
kinora.render.what.sequence: Render: the whole edit (all shots in order)
kinora.render.what.tooltip: One shot, or every shot of the edit with its transitions
kinora.render.fps.tooltip: Frames per second. Click for the next, Shift-click for the previous.
kinora.render.format.tooltip: The file to make. Video needs FFmpeg; an image sequence does not.
kinora.render.format.h264_nvenc: MP4, H.264 on the NVIDIA GPU (fast)
kinora.render.format.hevc_nvenc: MP4, H.265 on the NVIDIA GPU (fast)
kinora.render.format.h264_amf: MP4, H.264 on the AMD GPU (fast)
kinora.render.format.hevc_amf: MP4, H.265 on the AMD GPU (fast)
kinora.render.format.h264_qsv: MP4, H.264 on the Intel GPU (fast)
kinora.render.format.hevc_qsv: MP4, H.265 on the Intel GPU (fast)
kinora.render.quality.tooltip.h264: CRF: lower is better and bigger. 18 is visually lossless, 23 is FFmpeg's default.
kinora.render.quality.tooltip.h265: CRF: lower is better and bigger. 20 is a good start.
kinora.render.quality.tooltip.h264_nvenc: CQ: Lower is better and bigger. 21 looks like H.264 CRF 18. The GPU encodes in about a third of the time, into bigger files.
kinora.render.quality.tooltip.hevc_nvenc: CQ: Lower is better and bigger. 23 looks like H.264 CRF 18. The GPU encodes in about a third of the time, into bigger files.
kinora.render.quality.tooltip.h264_amf: QP: Lower is better and bigger. 20 looks like H.264 CRF 18. The GPU encodes in about a third of the time, into bigger files.
kinora.render.quality.tooltip.hevc_amf: QP: Lower is better and bigger. 22 looks like H.264 CRF 18. The GPU encodes in about a third of the time, into bigger files.
kinora.render.quality.tooltip.h264_qsv: Quality: Lower is better and bigger. 21 looks like H.264 CRF 18. The GPU encodes in about a third of the time, into bigger files.
kinora.render.quality.tooltip.hevc_qsv: Quality: Lower is better and bigger. 23 looks like H.264 CRF 18. The GPU encodes in about a third of the time, into bigger files.
kinora.render.quality.tooltip.av1: CRF: lower is better and bigger. 28 is a good start.
kinora.render.quality.tooltip.prores: ProRes profile: 0 proxy, 1 LT, 2 standard, 3 HQ, 4 4444, 5 4444 XQ.
kinora.render.quality.tooltip.prores4444: ProRes profile: 4 is 4444, 5 is 4444 XQ. Keeps alpha.
kinora.render.quality.tooltip.png16: Lossless: no quality setting. 16 bits keep motion blur and dissolves smooth.
kinora.render.quality.tooltip.exr: Half-float linear light with ZIP compression: no quality setting.
kinora.render.quality.tooltip.vp9: CRF: lower is better and bigger. 32 is a good start.
kinora.render.blur.tooltip: Renders several moments per frame and blends them, like a film camera's shutter (180 degrees). More samples are smoother and slower.
kinora.render.supersampling.tooltip: Renders larger and scales down, for smoother edges. 2x takes about four times as long.
kinora.render.file_name.tooltip: {project}, {shot} and {date} are filled in. Saved in kinora/renders.
kinora.render.images_note: Image sequences need no extra software.
kinora.render.ffmpeg_missing: FFmpeg not found: put ffmpeg.exe in kinora/tools or set its path in settings.
kinora.queue.title: Render queue
kinora.queue.other_replay: This render is for another replay: open that replay first.
kinora.render.passes.tooltip: Depth pass: an EXR per frame in a _depth folder beside the output, with each pixel's distance in blocks. Transparent sky: the sky becomes alpha, for compositing (needs PNG, EXR, ProRes 4444 or FFV1).
kinora.render.no_encoder: Your FFmpeg has no %s encoder. Pick another format, or use a "full" FFmpeg build.
kinora.render.no_audio: The video was made without sound
kinora.render.projection.tooltip: Normal, a 360° panorama (six renders per frame, ignores the camera's pitch and roll), a cube map, or stereo 3D for headsets and 3D players.
kinora.render.sound.tooltip: The replay's sounds, heard from the camera. Tape pitch lowers sound in slow motion like a slowed tape; keep pitch does not. Sounds are left out below 1/8 and above 8x speed.
kinora.inspector.add_track.tooltip: Key a look, lens or world track at the playhead: grading, depth of field, letterbox, time of day, weather...

kinora.palette.loop: Loop the preview on or off

kinora.palette.start: Go to the start of the shot
kinora.palette.end: Go to the end of the shot
kinora.palette.live_cut: Live cut: direct while the replay plays
kinora.live.title: Live cut
kinora.live.no_cameras: Make some shots first: the first nine are the cameras.
kinora.live.started: %s cameras. 1-9 cut; finish with the live-cut key.
kinora.live.done: %s shots are now the edit (the old project is saved as a version; Ctrl+Z undoes).
kinora.palette.clear_path: Path: move it out of blocks
kinora.path.title: Camera path
kinora.path.clear: The path is clear of blocks.
kinora.path.fixed: The path is clear of blocks now (keys added: %s; Ctrl+Z undoes).
kinora.path.left: Keys added: %s. Stretches still in blocks (red): %s; there is no clear place within 4 blocks across the path.
kinora.palette.look_copy: Look: copy this shot's grading, effects and shake
kinora.palette.look_paste: Look: paste the copied look into this shot
kinora.palette.look_all: Look: give every shot this shot's look
kinora.look.title: Look
kinora.look.applied: %s other shots now look like %s (Ctrl+Z undoes).
kinora.palette.pick_target: Pick the rig target (click an entity)
kinora.palette.pick_look: Look at... (click an entity or a block)
kinora.keys.title: Replay keys
kinora.guide.title: Making a shot in six steps
kinora.guide.fly: %s. Fly: hold the right mouse button over the world and use W A S D, Space and Shift. The mouse wheel changes speed.
kinora.guide.shot: %s. New Shot (Ctrl+N) starts a 5-second shot at the current moment of the replay.
kinora.guide.key: %s. Press I to key the camera at the playhead. Move the playhead (drag the ruler, or End / arrow keys), fly somewhere else, press I again.
kinora.guide.preview: %s. Space plays the shot. F switches between the shot's camera and flying freely. The blue line in the world is the camera's path (H hides it).
kinora.guide.palette: %s. Ctrl+K finds any action: templates, rigs, look-at, grading, depth of field, time of day...
kinora.guide.render: %s. Render makes the video. Esc stops a render; it resumes from the queue.
kinora.guide.close: Click or press any key to start. The ? button shows this again.
